note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. folkwang (AR/Water/Defender/Burst II) is a pure sustain kit: every line is shield / heal / taunt / self-Max-HP. She contributes ZERO direct damage effects. Her only damage-relevant channel is TANDEM: the shield events (skill1 + burst, 2 highest-final-ATK allies) fire teammates' `shielded` triggers, and the burst's over-time recovery fires their `recovery` triggers — per the hard rule that heal/shield/DEF/HP/lifesteal lines are never skipped on isolation. The burst lifesteal (65.81% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec) is modeled as a 10-tick heal (1s interval) so on-recovery consumers stay refreshed across the window rather than seeing a single instant event. Both non-burst skills are ⚑ interval-triggered at an ESTIMATED cadence — the kit prose gives no activation clause for either, which is the single largest uncertainty in this baseline.
